: 34°21′28″N 85°40′39″W ﻿ / ﻿ 34.3578°N 85.6774°W ﻿ / 34.3578; -85.6774 From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Waterfall in Alabama, United States Grace's High Falls is a seasonal waterfall in the US state of Alabama , in Little River Canyon National Preserve . The waterfall is Alabama's highest at 133 feet.
